headline: Dallah Healthcare's half-year revenue rises 11.9% amid increased visits to its hospitals and centers
summary: Dallah Healthcare reported revenue growth of 11.9% for the period ended June 30, 2026. Growth came from more patient visits, new acquisitions and enhanced operations at existing facilities.
why: Dallah Healthcare is a Saudi hospital operator, and its results indicate demand trends in the Saudi private healthcare sector.
